executor: author, with repository CI for platform regression checks
scope: Established session connection idle handling and exact-identity reconnect
Nonblocking latest-frame access and ordered background layout saves
Checkpoint capture and persistence without a shared runtime lock during waits
dataIsolation: Private temporary HOME, profiles and real local test shells. Pause or terminate only test-owned processes. Never restart the installed app or service, send input to live user sessions, access provider accounts or use physical devices.
checks: Record failing regressions before the implementation changes
Leave an established connection quiet for longer than ten seconds; verify the same server and shell PID, continued output and subsequent input
Pause a test frontend and interrupt transport; verify exact-run reconnection, no duplicate commands, no queued input replay and no replayed clipboard or notification effects
Change server/run identity or protocol; preserve existing processes and require explicit stopped-session recovery instead of automatic execution
Delay a Poll response under test control; last-frame access and GPUI input processing must complete while the response remains blocked
Delay layout checkpoint completion under test control; GPUI remains responsive and only the latest ordered layout survives window close and quit
Delay terminal capture and disk writes; unrelated pane input remains usable, pending saves remain bounded and stale-run completions are rejected
Retain current/previous checkpoint recovery, five-second dirty-output scheduling, durable layout/launch saves, failure visibility and confirmed save timestamps

Run real-shell multi-pane input/output measurements on freshly built same-candidate local and service backends; report median, p95, throughput, CPU and detached memory/disk without claiming native latency
cargo test --workspace on macOS with pinned Zig 0.16.0
Existing Linux tests and Windows build through repository CI
evidenceRules: Bind final regression and measurement evidence to the final candidate SHA or identical Git tree
Exploratory cached-binary measurements and the installed-1.5.0 reproduction are diagnosis, not final-candidate validation
Report unrun native rendering, signed artifact and public deployment checks as unrun
Preserve live user data and archive raw evidence to verified NAS storage
delivery: Reviewed Ready PR only; no release tag, publication or installed app replacement
